mode: agent
description: Update WORKLOG.md with completed todos, a dated accomplishments entry, and any new documentation links.
---

Update `WORKLOG.md` at the repo root to reflect the work just done in this
conversation, following the rules in `.github/copilot-instructions.md`
("Worklog maintenance"):

1. Read the current `WORKLOG.md` first.
2. Move any todos that were completed out of `## Todos` and into a new or
   existing `### YYYY-MM-DD` entry (today's date) under `## Accomplishments`,
   phrased as concrete completed facts.
3. Add any new follow-up todos that came out of this work to `## Todos`.
4. If any documentation was created or substantially updated for part of the
   code, add or update a line in `## Documentation Index` linking to it.
5. Make targeted edits only — do not rewrite past entries or the whole file.
